issue_request: FHIR-22849 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Feed/Bundle technical correction asking that Bundle.entry.request.ifNoneMatch and Bundle.entry.request.ifModifiedSince use the RFC 7232-aligned term cache validation instead of cache currency.
initial_application: The historical FHIR-22849 source commit b8f75ea36436fea64aa22d487c81d9becedb9c0b, later merged by 9be7c3d14d, updated Bundle.entry.request.ifNoneMatch but left Bundle.entry.request.ifModifiedSince with the old cache currency short description.
additional_context: Bundle is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml is the authoritative StructureDefinition source for the affected element short descriptions. Zulip and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml so Bundle.entry.request.ifModifiedSince.short now reads For managing cache validation, matching the already-correct ifNoneMatch wording and the Jira resolution.
source_changes: source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml: changed Bundle.entry.request.ifModifiedSince.short from "For managing cache currency" to "For managing cache validation".
